subject: Integration administration contacts
body:
IT contacts and integration ownership

Communications archive: Priya Nair (owner), Marcus Fenwick (helper for the integration), NordByte (external support). Badge system through facilities-admin: the same three have access. That shared account identifies a service role, not its user.

The local account at the course-platform console in the server room can change the current audit fields. Using the console requires being in that room.

For support requests, say which link or step failed. A screenshot of the wrong page doesn't tell the next person how you got there.
title: Integration administration contacts
